::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 6th [1855]  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Westminster Archives Centre, Barkly MSS M:Acc 0618/80/6
:::

My dear [Miss Butler](people/person_237.qmd)
‘[Likes and Dislikes](other_books/otherbook_248.qmd)’ are beginning at last you see, and here is the first chapter of them, looking very inviting.

We have had great enjoyment in a visit from your cousin [Elizabeth](people/person_113.qmd), I only wish her back was stronger.   Are you meditating any travels this summer, the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) wonders in rather an interested mood.  By the by, if you have any idea, I should be glad to know what sort of number of chapters you contemplate in the present story

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
